=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:102-107 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PHASE_LABELS tuple does not include "ai:waiting-on-dependency", but scripts/label_helpers.sh:159 _AI_PHASE_LABELS lists it right after "ai:blocked", so the mirror no longer matches.
  WHY: The parity test at tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py:267-270 fails ("At index 16 diff: 'ai:waiting-on-dependency' != 'ai:review-blocked'") and keeps CI job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator red; the post-merge verifier also misses parked issues, and `labels_after_reopen` (line 350-357, `drop = set(PHASE_LABELS) | {LABEL}`) can leave the wait label on a reopened issue. Four reviewers rated it MAJOR and gemini stated no severity. The fix is one line at line 106.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_scope_tests.py:1270-1276 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The freeze() helper builds a jq command that never binds $blocker_paths or $blocker_runs, but the freeze filter it loads uses both (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3161; production binds them at 3153-3154).
  WHY: jq fails to compile and exits with status 3, so test_freeze_filter_adds_suspect_files_only_when_non_empty raises CalledProcessError on every run and CI job tests-heal-plan-and-validation (run 42777788862, job/129700268927) stays red. The fix is to add "blocker_runs": [] and "blocker_paths": [] to args, as the sibling test at line 798 already does.
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:2217-2219 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The DEP_WAIT_RAW perl scan in "Parse planning output" does not toggle on fences, but `first_waiting_line` in scripts/dependency_wait_resume.py (WAITING_FENCE_RE) and the clarify-side scan (.github/workflows/clarify.yml:2092-2096) do. With an unclosed fence before a valid WAITING: line, bash finds the line and the helper returns status "none".
  WHY: A valid pending dependency wait then falls through to ai:blocked with the raw "WAITING: ..." reason instead of being parked, which is the stuck state the issue is meant to remove; the fallback fails safe. Severities disagree: sonnet NIT, minimax MAJOR; the highest is used here.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1104-1143 (also 37-39, 266-269, 1318-1319) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The 180-second RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS deadline is checked only between items (line 1142). It is not checked before the initial `_drain_retired_label` / `_list_open_items_with_label` listing (line 1104) or inside `_github_api_request`, which retries up to 3 times at 120 s each.
  WHY: A slow or rate-limited listing or request can run past both the deadline and the 5-minute timeout at .github/workflows/sync_ai_labels.yml:43. Actions then kills the job before the LABEL_SYNC_RETIRED_DRAIN_DEFERRED outcome is recorded. Severity was MAJOR from all three reviewers.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:34-38, 1139-1142, 1315-1319 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The retired-label drain deadline work (P11a: RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS, `_retired_label_drain_deadline`) is bundled into this P8a-2 PR (issue #8880), and scripts/ai_labels.py is outside the plan grant's files_touched.
  WHY: This breaks §9 and §20 scope rules, is tied to the tests/test_ai_labels.py and tests/test_ai_labels_retired.py::test_repo_contract_retires_the_claude_session_labels regressions, and the deadline logic itself is flawed (see the deadline finding above). minimax rated it MAJOR; gemini stated no severity.
- (CI) orchestrate-poll (0) job/129700269203 and orchestrate-poll (2) job/129700269241, run 42777788862 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both jobs failed on head 81a39813aa8dcf32d2a5331dc7baf80422b73172, but the captured log tails show only PASS lines and in-test ##[error] fixture prints, so the failing step cannot be mapped to a hunk in this diff.
  WHY: The head check status stays red, and the editor has to read the full failed-job log (gh run view --log-failed 42777788862) to tell whether this PR caused the failure or inherited it. Severities disagree: sonnet NIT, glm MAJOR; the highest is used here.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2670; .github/workflows/plan.yml:3936 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the FP_JOB_ID jq expression, `//` does not catch the error `capture` raises on an empty or unmatched check_run_url. The error aborts the array build and FP_JOB_ID ends up empty.
  WHY: The annotations lookup is skipped silently, so the failure-fingerprint marker is emitted without its error line, which weakens the breaker's signature. The path fails open and is rare (NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this claim and rejected it: in its reading capture returns no output rather than an error, so the fallback applies.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:2670; .github/workflows/plan.yml:3936 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN DIFF rewrites the FP_JOB_ID jq expression in the "Comment on issue failure" steps, which is P3a fingerprint-marker work outside the P8a-2 grant.
  WHY: The change is out of scope, and the planned P3a PR will have to re-land it; runtime impact is bounded because the `^[1-9][0-9]*$` guard fails open.
- README.md:109-114 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The four new env-var rows (SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_UNIFIED_ENABLED, RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_ENABLED, ZOMBIE_RUN_REAPER_ENABLED, ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS) document switches from other phases, and P8a-2 adds no env vars.
  WHY: The docs are split from the PRs that implement them and may go stale, and the rows are out of the P8a-2 grant. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this: in their reading the rows came in through the merge from main, or document merged phases.
- agents.d/stuck-states-p11a-retired-label-drain.md:1-2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The appended sentence documents RETIRED_LABEL_DRAIN_DEADLINE_SECONDS = 180 s and the per-item budget check, which describe a script change outside this PR's grant.
  WHY: If the ai_labels.py change is reverted, the fragment describes behaviour that does not exist; if it is kept, the fragment and the implementation live in different PRs and drift apart.
- scripts/ai_labels.py:1315-1319 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_retired_label_drain_deadline` is a module-level mutable that `_delete_retired_labels` resets to time.monotonic() + 180 on every call.
  WHY: Any other entry point that imports the module in the same process shares the global, so a second drain can read a stale or already-expired deadline and silently break its budget.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/plan.yml:lines 2217-2219 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The DEP_WAIT_RAW perl scan has no fence check. CODEX_OUTPUT_PARSE_FILE (built at lines 2196-2201) removes only closed fences, while `first_waiting_line` toggles on WAITING_FENCE_RE. With an unclosed fence, bash finds the WAITING: line and the helper returns {"status":"none"}.
  WHY: A valid pending wait is never parked, takes the ai:blocked path, and needs a human /answer; the fallback near line 2272 is fail-safe. Suggested fix: skip the fence toggle in parse-waiting for plan.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:lines 102-106 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: PHASE_LABELS is missing "ai:waiting-on-dependency", which scripts/label_helpers.sh:159 _AI_PHASE_LABELS lists; tests/test_persist_postmerge_verify.py:270 asserts parity.
  WHY: CI tests-hooks-and-orchestrator fails with "At index 16 diff: 'ai:waiting-on-dependency' != 'ai:review-blocked'", and the verifier misses parked issues. Fix: insert the label after "ai:blocked" on line 106.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_scope_tests.py:lines 1270-1274 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: freeze() never binds blocker_paths or blocker_runs, but the filter from _lw_freeze_filter() (line 778) references both, so jq exits with status 3. The sibling test at line 798 does bind them.
  WHY: test_freeze_filter_adds_suspect_files_only_when_non_empty raises CalledProcessError, keeping tests-heal-plan-and-validation (run 42777788862, job/129700268927) red on head 81a39813. Fix: add the two keys to args at line 1267.
- (CI) orchestrate-poll (0) job/129700269203 and orchestrate-poll (2) job/129700269241, run 42777788862 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The failing step is outside the captured tail, so it cannot be traced to a hunk.
  WHY: The head check stays red, and the editor must read the full log to decide whether the PR caused it or inherited it.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Every granted deliverable has a hunk: the prompt rule in all copies, parse-waiting and park, staging, the clarify.yml and plan.yml steps, the README, docs and fragments, and the tests.
- Rejected after verification (3 related items): the FP_JOB_ID jq at clarify.yml:2670 and plan.yml:3936 does not abort, because the "// .id" fallback applies; the scripts/ai_labels.py deadline, the README rows 109-114 and the agents.d/stuck-states-p11a and p3a edits came from the merge with main and are not scope creep; gemini's "self_reference rejects same-repo PRs" claim is wrong, because _is_self_target rejects only number == issue_number.
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/plan.yml line 2453, the comment "# Stuck-states P8a-2 (Refs #8291): park a validated WAITING: answer in", is indented 20 spaces instead of 10; re-indent it (1 line). scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py line 106: insert "ai:waiting-on-dependency" (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
